notes: Store machine-wide settings in <DSH_HOME>/generalrouter/host.local.json; a project's host.local.json is an optional partial override.
state_dir is always resolved inside the active workspace, even when these settings are shared. Relative routing/rates/quota files are resolved beside the configuration that defines them.
The plugin bundles 12 enabled callable mappings in runtime/data/model-call-mappings.v0.1.json. Leave routes empty to use them; entries here are optional overrides.
The bundled mappings use DSH provider easy-cliproxyapi. The user configures that provider, the actual model catalog, the subagent allowlist and supported effort metadata in DSH App.
Copy the bundled quota policy example to quota.local.json and configure only the local ECPA management connection. Account/model quota metadata is read directly; no quota groups are configured.
DSH must already expose the same exact provider/model pairs in the new session's subagent allowlist.
reasoning_effort is used only when supported by the host model metadata; otherwise it is omitted and the provider default is recorded.
Null routing_config and rates_file use the plugin's bundled runtime files. Explicit custom paths are resolved beside this configuration.
Quota is read once on first use, then at most every 600 seconds during activity. No idle polling or estimated percentage deduction is performed.
